title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: 30 vendors at a time, none repeated or skipped
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure that between 31 and 90 vendors have overdue bills on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV and count the vendors in it (each name once).
  3. Count the vendors shown before any more load (or compare them with the first 30 names in the CSV) and note the last one.
  4. Scroll down until the next vendors load.
  5. Keep scrolling to the end of the list, writing down each vendor's name.
  6. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  7. Scroll from the top to the end of the list again, writing down each name.
  8. In the Past due filter, tick "1-30 days".
  9. Tick "91+ days".
  10. Scroll from the top to the end of the list again, writing down each name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 2:

  • Note the number of vendors (for example 46).

Step 3:

  • Exactly 30 vendors.

Step 4:

  • The next vendors load below as you scroll (there are no page buttons), starting with the vendor that comes right after the last one noted in step 3, not a repeat.

Step 5:

  • Every vendor appears exactly once and the count equals the CSV's.

Step 6:

  • The rows sort by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 7:

  • In this sort too, every vendor appears exactly once and none is missing.

Step 8:

  • The chip reads "Past due: 1-30 days" and the report reloads with that range only.

Step 9:

  • The chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" and the report reloads with both ranges.

Step 10:

  • Every vendor left by the filter appears exactly once.
  • None repeats as more load.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”
